notes:
Scope: the accepted application is src/BMCIlluminatiPass.sol (constructor 174-188), with eight nonpayable static constructor arguments. $owner receives ownership. StandardArt is internal and needs no deployment. Candidate V3 is preserved only in test/audit/fixtures/BMCIlluminatiPassCandidateV3.sol; it is not the application listed here. The subscription and 500-gwei lane match the requested branch's dry-run script at bf2a63c04d0e73a1a1b9c65a785d921526ec39b0. 500000 callback gas, 3 confirmations and native payment match script/Deploy.s.sol:27-37. No application initialization or deployment ETH is required.

Security verdict: Candidate V3 is NOT MAINNET READY. Full report, source links, reproductions and fixes: docs/SECURITY-REVIEW.md; evidence: docs/TEST-RESULTS.md and docs/audit/PROVENANCE.md. V3 locations below refer to src/experimental/BMCIlluminatiPassCandidateV3.sol at the pinned upstream commit. HIGH H-1 (252-275,302-310): mint 40 Genesis and one mystery NFT, close, request the sole seed, then drop delivery or fail its callback; another request and finalization remain impossible while BMC stays burned. HIGH H-2 (178-205,256-271): cancel the subscription or remove its lane after minting; immutable configuration strands the seed request. MEDIUM M-1 (188,191): V3's dynamic CID string cannot fit this manifest ABI, and an expired absolute deadline reverts construction. LOW L-1 (302-310): a 150000-gas callback suffices, so 500000 inflates V3's funding buffer. LOW L-2 (308,323-349,424-436): outcomes are computable after seed delivery while metadata stays pending. LOW L-3 (252-275): a zero-mint sale can request a useless seed. LOW L-4: the original mock's immediate-funding test does not model service expiry.

Accepted production revision (src/BMCIlluminatiPass.sol): P-M1 medium fixed, every mint and retry staticcalls the coordinator's s_provingKeys and reverts on an unregistered lane, rolling back the BMC burn (285-289); the constructor makes no external call. P-L3 low fixed with Ownable2Step (41) and disabled renounceOwnership (195-197). P-L4 low fixed by disclosing computable pending outcomes (546). P-L1 and P-L2 low retained by design: an underfunded subscription still accepts burns and requests (255-265), and one-day permissionless retries (271-277) can charge the subscription for ignored deliveries (329-350); the first delivered word wins and no stored word can be discarded. Immutable-coordinator dependence remains. Burn checks verify exact payer and total-supply reductions and reject fake burns and wrong decimals; reentrancy is blocked; full-sale tests cover 77 unique Genesis and 423 unique Standard outcomes. Production has no deadline; V3 rejects minting at its deadline and leaves unsold NFTs unminted. All 77 Genesis files reproduce the immutable CID; continued IPFS availability requires pinning.

Release limitations: on a Mainnet fork at block 26177421 the nominated subscription belonged to the specified owner with 0 LINK, 0.02 ETH and zero consumers, and the lane reported registered at 500 gwei. Consumer registration, adequate funding and retained owner access are external operator preconditions; do not open sales before them. No unconditional Mainnet approval is implied.

Verification on this tree: forge build passed; forge test 87 passed, 0 failed, 4 skipped (offline fork skips); the ten dedicated Mainnet fork tests passed against a public RPC at block 26177421. Earlier independent rerun of the upstream non-fork suite: 80 passed, 0 failed. Runtime size is 23757 bytes, under EIP-170; the factory test confirms zero-value construction with codeless dependencies and no forbidden opcodes. Finding tests reproduce defects; no live oracle fulfillment or independent certification is claimed. Audit and local simulations only; no live deployment, broadcast or signing.
